# FQHESphereExtractRootPartitions

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereExtractRootPartitions`

Manual: [FQHESphereExtractRootPartitions (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/FQHESphereExtractRootPartitions.md)

```text
FQHESphereExtractRootPartitions, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereExtractRootPartitions [options] 

Options:

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

main options:
    --input-file : name of the file which contains the spectrum
    --eigenstate-list : use a list of eigenstates instead of extracting the information from the spectrum
    --energy-error : energy below which a state is considered as a zero energy states (default value = 1e-10)
    --component-error : value below which norm of a vector component is assumed to be zero (default value = 1e-08)
    --output-precision : numerical display precision (value must be greater than 2 and lower than 14, default value = 14)
    -o, --output : output name for the root partition list (default name uses input-file, replacing dat extension with root)
    --save-states : save the states corresponding to each root configuration
    --rational : use rational numbers instead of double precision floating point numbers
    --4-D : use a Hilbert space with SO(5) symmetry (only available in eigenstate-list mode)
    --PES-eigenstate : use a list of reduced density matrix eigenstates instead of energy eigenstates

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
